problem_statement: Fix the astropy.io.ascii.qdp case-insensitivity bug completely. QDP commands such as read serr 1 2 and read terr 1 must be accepted regardless of capitalization, and masked data tokens such as no must also be accepted regardless of capitalization. Inspect all parsing paths in astropy/io/ascii/qdp.py for uppercase-only assumptions and make the minimal complete production-source change. Modify exactly astropy/io/ascii/qdp.py; do not create or modify tests, scripts, documentation, or any other files. Before finalizing, verify the patch contains only that one production source file.
